note: Purchase is more formal register than buy; truth conditions match.
Abandon is more formal/dramatic than phrasal 'give up'; same event.
Postpone is formal Latinate; 'put off' is informal phrasal verb.
Light-verb construction adds slight formality/emphasis vs simple verb 'answer'.
Idiom 'kick the bucket' is informal/humorous; 'die' is neutral register.
Light-verb 'take a walk' bounds the activity; subtle aspectual difference.
Exhausted may denote stronger degree than merely 'very tired'.
